name: Format

pricing.free_plan: 14-day trial, no credit card. No permanent free plan.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.note: billed annually, 14 if billed monthly; 10 pages, 70 images

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.note: billed annually; unlimited pages, 1500 images, custom domain, 50 client galleries

tiers.name: Pro Plus
tiers.note: billed annually; unlimited images, 1 TB storage, 250 galleries

pricing.publish_note: The 14-day trial cannot publish ("Website Launching Soon").

capabilities: Portfolio themes built for photography, not adapted from a generic builder
Client galleries with password protection on paid plans
Custom domain included in the first year on Pro and Pro Plus
limits: Trial only: nothing can stay online without a paid plan
Client galleries are capped by tier (3 / 50 / 250)
Not a general app builder: no database, no custom logic
Verified 06.11.2026: a trial site cannot go live — portfolio-uzarbjj.format.com shows 'Website Launching Soon' and there is no publish control before a plan is active
summary: Portfolio platform built for photographers, with client galleries and a store.

custom_domain.detail: Free custom domain in the first year on paid plans

client_galleries.detail: Client galleries per tier: 3 on the entry plan, up to 250

payments.detail: Online store, commission-free on paid tiers

not_testable.reason: The trial cannot publish and there is no lasting free plan; publishing needs a subscription.
